description: Separate layer-decomposition Candidate, not a general Qwen Image Edit variant: one Spark converts one input image into 1–4 transparent PNG layers at the pinned 640-pixel, 50-step schedule. Four remains the default and maximum offered count. The pinned Diffusers pipeline allocates a latent frame batch proportional to layers + 1, so counts above four are withheld until native memory qualification establishes a larger resource envelope.
title: Qwen Image Layered Diffusers single Spark
